rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh! Adel-sama! I heard that
the capital's been attacked!

rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0002
rows.name:
So... it really happened... What an
awful thing to do...

rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0003
rows.name:
At least Aletta hasn't fallen
into large-scale disorder yet.
It's still fairly safe here.

rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0004
rows.name:
But everyone at the manor and your
wife are very worried about Adel-sama
and the others.

rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0005
rows.name:
They're deeply concerned but they
won't, and can't, tell you to come
home. They understand that.

rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0006
rows.name:
If it comes to that, we'll follow your
orders and open the manor's supplies
to people in need.

rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0007
rows.name:
I'll make sure that we're
mentally and logistically
prepared for that, Adel-sama.

rows.label: tlk70000052_03_msg0008
rows.name:
Please, Adel-sama... Don't
overextend yourself trying to
resolve this situation too quickly.
